ModMetaData.name: Recolor Work Priorities
ModMetaData.author: Riketta
ModMetaData.description:
Shifts the work tab's manual priority colors one tier up: priority 2 wears priority 1's green, priority 3 wears priority 2's yellow, and top priority gets a new cyan that stands out from both at a glance. Priority 4 keeps its vanilla grey, and all three shifted colors are configurable in mod settings.
The low-skill warning border moves one tier up as well: work boxes of active work the pawn is bad at are highlighted from skill 3 and below (vanilla highlights only 2 and below). The threshold is configurable and the priority tooltips follow both the threshold and the shifted colors, so warnings keep their look.
Works with the vanilla work tab and with Fluffy's Work Tab - when that mod is detected, its detailed priority colors are shifted the same way and its warning border follows the same threshold. Everything degrades gracefully: if a game or Work Tab update moves something, the affected piece simply stays vanilla instead of erroring.
Requires the Harmony mod. Nothing is hardcoded to specific work types, and the mod is safe to add or remove at any time.
Source code & details: https://github.com/Riketta/RecolorWorkPriorities
